content: शिल्पम् [शिल्-पक् <ls>Uṇ. 3. 28</ls>] .²1 An art, a fine or mechanical art; (64 such arts are enumerated). .²2 Skill (in any art); craft; शिल्पोपचारयुक्ताश्च निपुणाः पण्ययोषितः <ls>Ms. 9. 259</ls>; पात्रविशेषे न्यस्तं गुणान्तरं व्रजति शिल्पमाधातुः <ls>M. 1. 6</ls>. .²3 Ingenuity, cleverness. .²4 Work, manual work or labour; विसर्गरत्यर्त्यभिजल्पशिल्पाः <ls>Bhāg. 5. 11. 10</ls>. .²5 A rite, ceremony. .²6 A kind of ladle or spoon used at sacrifices. .²7 Form, shape. .²8 Creation, procreation.
